context.body: Royal testimony becomes bodily prayer before the gathered nation.

observations.body: Solomon blesses Israel, recounts David’s desire and his own building, kneels with spread hands, and asks God to hear.
observations.label: Solomon kneels before the assembly: action

observations.body: The king publicly interprets dynasty, city, house, covenant, and prayer.
observations.label: Solomon kneels before the assembly: response

observations.body: chosen Jerusalem · David desired · knelt · hear from heaven

payload.posture: Read 2 Chronicles 6:1–21 as ark, prayer, and dedication evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: Chosen place and chosen dynasty remain dependent on God’s hearing rather than ownership of God.
